name: cal
description: The calendar inside Timeline's date and mood card (v4 C1): a month and year wheel beside one month's days, Monday first, the days marked by mood. A day written is a link; a day with nothing is a plain number, no tap target.

month.description: The wheel's listbox name ("Month and year").

months.description: Every month the wheel offers, oldest first, from the first month written to this month (never a future one): { value: "2026-08", short: "Aug", year: "2026", name: "August 2026", days, empty? }. days: { n, href?, mood?, current?, out?, label? } per cell, Monday first: href and mood (light|good|even|low|hard) on a day written, current on the day in view, out for a cell outside the month, label naming the day ("Sunday 9 August, Good. Go to this day"). empty: the note "Nothing written this month." under the grid.

selected.description: The value of the month shown and centred in the wheel (the current day's month).

states.hover: n/a: no hover treatment; a day link has the base link treatment
states.focus-visible: yes: the product focus ring on a day link (base)
states.active: yes: a day written presses 1px down
states.disabled: n/a: an empty day is not a control
states.selected: yes: selected month (aria-selected, --ink, semibold, centred between the wheel's two hairlines) and its current day (ringed)
states.loading: n/a: the months are drawn from known dates
states.empty: yes: a month with nothing written is all plain numbers, with the note under its grid

events.pick: a day written was chosen (bubbling; detail: { date: "YYYY-MM-DD" }); its link's default is prevented so the page can jump instead

a11y.role: a listbox of months (options) beside the shown month's grid, named by its month
a11y.keyboard: Up and Down move the selected month, a month option is pressed to show it; Tab through the days written
a11y.labels: each day link names the date and what it holds; each month option names month and year ("August 2026")

responsive.wheel: the month column is 76px wide at every width (the card is the calendar's width)

changelog.change: The wheel form (v4 C1): months beside the days, mood dots, the current day ringed, the empty-month note; cal.js for the wheel.
The wheel form follows data-current: the ring and the selected month move with the day in view (v4 C1 round 2).
The grid and nav forms (the zoom's month grid and the desktop index), the tag and form options and data-form: the wheel is the calendar's only form, its rules scoped by the root class alone.

behaviour.script: cal.js, the wheel form only, inside its root: centres the selected month in the wheel (padding the list so the first and last can centre); selecting by press, by scroll settling (120ms after the scroll stops, the month nearest the centre) or by Up/Down shows that month's grid and dispatches month; a day link dispatches pick. Smooth scrolling only without reduced motion (or with the review switch on). Exposes nothing else; opening and closing the calendar is its parent's. When its parent sets data-current (the wheel form), the ring moves to that day and the wheel shows and centres that day's month.

data-current.description: The wheel form: the day in view, set by the parent (the Timeline's card) as the list scrolls: its day is ringed and its month selected.
